markers.impact: APOE e4 isoform structural driver / LDL cholesterol elevations
markers.interpretation: APOE rs429358 C-allele determines the e4 isoform. Combined with rs7412, it defines the APOE haplotype. One or two copies of e4 drive higher LDL cholesterol, elevated cardiovascular risk, and late-onset Alzheimer's susceptibility.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Haplotype determination from single raw SNPs can occasionally fail if phasing is incorrect. Clinically confirm haplotype structure.

sources.name: APOE Haplotypes and Alzheimer's Risk Consensus
sources.notes: Documents the highly robust risk increase in APOE e4/e4 homozygotes.

markers.impact: APOE isoform determination (e2, e3, e4 haplotype)
markers.interpretation: Determines the APOE e2 vs e3/e4 isoform. T/T at rs7412 combined with T/T at rs429358 defines e2/e2 (associated with lower LDL but risk of Type III hyperlipoproteinemia). G/G at rs7412 combined with C/C at rs429358 defines e4/e4.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Haplotype phasing requires validating both APOE loci (rs429358 and rs7412) in tandem.

sources.name: APOE variant molecular classification
sources.notes: ClinVar catalog mapping the alleles to ApoE polypeptide variants.

markers.impact: Altered cell cycle regulation in vascular walls
markers.interpretation: The 9p21 non-coding region regulates vascular smooth muscle. The rs10757278 G allele is one of the most replicated risk markers for early-onset coronary artery disease and myocardial infarction, independent of lipid levels.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Polygenic hazard score; absolute risk is highly modifiable by dietary lipids, smoking, and blood pressure control.

sources.name: 9p21 locus association with coronary artery disease
sources.notes: Large GWAS identification of 9p21 non-coding risk variants for cardiovascular events.

markers.impact: Altered nitric oxide synthesis / vascular recovery
markers.interpretation: NOS3 synthesizes nitric oxide, which regulates vasodilation and blood flow. The T (Asp) allele reduces enzyme function, potentially impairing endothelial nitric oxide production, athletic recovery, and arterial dilation under stress.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Nitric oxide levels are highly modifiable by dietary inorganic nitrates (beets, leafy greens) and UV sunlight exposure.

sources.name: NOS3 Glu298Asp and vascular function
sources.notes: Shows reduction in endothelial nitric oxide synthase enzyme stability in T-carriers.

markers.impact: Reduced nitric oxide synthase promoter transcription
markers.interpretation: The C allele of rs2070744 is located in the NOS3 promoter, decreasing transcription rate. Associated with reduced basal nitric oxide production. Works synergistically with rs1799983 to affect vascular tone.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Exercise training induces NOS3 transcription and can overcome genetic promoter reductions.

sources.name: NOS3 promoter polymorphism and coronary spasm
sources.notes: Demonstrates reduction in reporter gene transcription driven by the -786C variant.
